description: Surrogate primary key, generated always as an identity column. Internal, not stable across releases.

Stable vehicle identifier. Use this rather than key to refer to a vehicle type. Open set: further vehicle types may appear in later releases. A cataloged vehicle type need not carry rows in raw_data.vehicle_parameters: only the types a batch actually parametrizes appear there.
Broad vehicle class. 'Ground' denotes a truck, 'Autonomous' a delivery robot. Use this to separate truck from robot parameters when reading raw_data.vehicle_parameters.
Free-text description of the vehicle type. NULL where none was recorded.
